```{python}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import scanpy as sc
import decoupler as dc
import scipy.sparse as sp
from itertools import permutations
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind, spearmanr, rankdata
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests

# ---------------- settings ----------------
ADATA_PATH   = "2_car_only_annotated_v3.h5ad"
PATIENT_COL  = "Patient"
TIME_COL     = "Timepoint_bin"
SUBSET_COL   = "labels"
SUBSET       = "DN T"
EARLY_LABEL  = "Early"
LATE_LABEL   = "Late"
N_SIG        = 100
MIN_FRAC     = 0.05      # keep genes detected in >=5% of early cells
EXCLUDE_SIG_FROM_EARLY = False   # True: remove signature genes before pathway scoring
N_PERM       = 10000     # used only if the number of patients is too large to enumerate
LFC_MIN = 0.5
SEED         = 0
rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)

def to_dense(X):
    return X.toarray() if hasattr(X, "toarray") else np.asarray(X)

# ---------------- load and define contrasts ----------------
adata = sc.read_h5ad(ADATA_PATH)
obs = adata.obs
is_late_dn = ((obs[TIME_COL] == LATE_LABEL) & (obs[SUBSET_COL] == SUBSET)).values
is_early   = (obs[TIME_COL] == EARLY_LABEL).values
adata.obs["contrast"] = np.where(is_late_dn, "Late_DNT", "other")

# ---------------- signature pseudobulk (summed counts, log-CPM) ----------------
pb = dc.pp.pseudobulk(adata, sample_col=PATIENT_COL, groups_col="contrast",
                      layer="counts", mode="sum")
dc.pp.filter_samples(pb, min_cells=5, min_counts=1000)   # in place
pb_df = pb.to_df()
lib = pb_df.sum(axis=1)
pb_df = np.log1p(pb_df.div(lib, axis=0) * 1e6)
pb_obs = pb.obs.copy()

# ---------------- labeled patients ----------------
early_pats = set(obs.loc[is_early, PATIENT_COL].unique())
late_pats  = set(obs.loc[is_late_dn, PATIENT_COL].unique())
labeled = sorted(early_pats & late_pats)
print(f"{len(labeled)} labeled patients: {labeled}")

late_dn = adata[is_late_dn].copy()

# ---------------- helpers ----------------
def derive_signature(train_patients, n=N_SIG):
    """Top-n up and down genes by t-statistic, among genes passing |log2FC| >= LFC_MIN."""
    m = pb_obs[PATIENT_COL].isin(train_patients).values
    d = pb_df[m]
    lab = pb_obs["contrast"].values[m]
    if (lab == "Late_DNT").sum() < 2 or (lab == "other").sum() < 2:
        return None
    a, b = d[lab == "Late_DNT"], d[lab == "other"]

    # Welch t-test on log-CPM
    t, _ = ttest_ind(a.values, b.values, axis=0, equal_var=False, nan_policy="omit")
    stats = pd.Series(t, index=d.columns).dropna()

    # log2 fold change on the CPM scale, with a pseudocount of 1
    cpm_a = np.expm1(a).mean()
    cpm_b = np.expm1(b).mean()
    lfc = np.log2((cpm_a + 1) / (cpm_b + 1)).reindex(stats.index)

    up   = stats[lfc >= LFC_MIN].sort_values(ascending=False).head(n).index.tolist()
    down = stats[lfc <= -LFC_MIN].sort_values(ascending=True).head(n).index.tolist()
    return {"up": up, "down": down}

def patient_score(sig):
    """Per-patient mean(up) - mean(down) across late DN cells."""
    late_dn.obs.drop(columns=["sig_up", "sig_down"], errors="ignore", inplace=True)
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=late_dn.obs[PATIENT_COL].unique())
    if sig["up"]:
        sc.tl.score_genes(late_dn, sig["up"], score_name="sig_up")
        out["sig_up"] = late_dn.obs.groupby(PATIENT_COL, observed=True)["sig_up"].mean()
    if sig["down"]:
        sc.tl.score_genes(late_dn, sig["down"], score_name="sig_down")
        out["sig_down"] = late_dn.obs.groupby(PATIENT_COL, observed=True)["sig_down"].mean()
    return out.get("sig_up", 0) - out.get("sig_down", 0)

def spearman_all(R, yr):
    """Column-wise Spearman between a rank matrix R (patients x features) and ranked y."""
    Rc = R - R.mean(axis=0)
    yc = yr - yr.mean()
    return (Rc * yc[:, None]).sum(axis=0) / np.sqrt((Rc**2).sum(axis=0) * (yc**2).sum())

# ---------------- early pseudobulk over ALL early cells ----------------
early_all = adata[is_early].copy()
detected = np.asarray((early_all.X > 0).mean(axis=0)).ravel()
genes = early_all.var_names[detected >= MIN_FRAC]
print(f"{len(genes)} genes kept from {early_all.n_vars}")

codes = pd.Categorical(early_all.obs[PATIENT_COL])
M = sp.csr_matrix((np.ones(early_all.n_obs),
                   (codes.codes, np.arange(early_all.n_obs))),
                  shape=(len(codes.categories), early_all.n_obs))
M = sp.diags(1 / np.asarray(M.sum(axis=1)).ravel()) @ M
early_pb = pd.DataFrame(to_dense(M @ early_all[:, genes].X),
                        index=codes.categories, columns=genes)
early_pb = early_pb.loc[labeled]

# ---------------- full-cohort signature and target ----------------
sig_full = derive_signature(labeled)
if sig_full is None:
    raise ValueError("Signature is empty on all labeled patients. Check the sample counts.")
sig_genes = set(sig_full["up"] + sig_full["down"])
y = patient_score(sig_full).loc[labeled]

from itertools import permutations
from scipy.stats import t as tdist, rankdata
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests

# ---------------- databases ----------------
# (file, prefix that the ID column must start with, or None for no filter)
GMT_FILES = {
    "Hallmark": ("h.all.v2026.1.Hs.symbols.gmt", None),
    "GO_BP":    ("c5.go.v2026.1.Hs.symbols.gmt", None),
    "KEGG":     ("c2.cp.kegg_legacy.v2026.1.Hs.symbols.gmt", None),
    "Reactome": ("ReactomePathways.gmt", "R-HSA"),
    "ImmuneSigDB": ("c7.immunesigdb.v2026.1.Hs.symbols.gmt", None),
}
MIN_SET, MAX_SET = 15, 300

def read_gmt(path, require_prefix=None):
    rows = []
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            parts = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
            if len(parts) < 3:
                continue
            name, desc, genes = parts[0], parts[1], parts[2:]
            if require_prefix and not desc.startswith(require_prefix):
                continue
            rows += [(name, g) for g in genes if g]
    net = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["source", "target"]).drop_duplicates()
    sizes = net.groupby("source").size()
    keep = sizes[(sizes >= MIN_SET) & (sizes <= MAX_SET)].index
    return net[net["source"].isin(keep)]

# ---------------- jackknife targets, computed once and reused for every database ----------------
jk_targets = {}
for held in labeled:
    train = [p for p in labeled if p != held]
    sig_j = derive_signature(train)
    if sig_j is None:
        print(f"jackknife skip {held}: no usable signature")
        continue
    jk_targets[held] = (train, patient_score(sig_j).loc[train])

# ---------------- per-database analysis ----------------
n = len(labeled)
yr = rankdata(y.values)

def score_database(net, db):
    out = dc.mt.ulm(data=early_pb, net=net)
    A = out[0] if isinstance(out, tuple) else out
    A = A.loc[labeled]
    A = A.loc[:, A.std() > 0]
    Ar = A.rank(axis=0).values

    r = pd.Series(spearman_all(Ar, yr), index=A.columns)
    t_stat = r * np.sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - r**2 + 1e-12))
    p_raw = pd.Series(2 * tdist.sf(np.abs(t_stat), df=n - 2), index=A.columns)

    # max-statistic null within this database
    perms = permutations(range(n)) if n <= 8 else (rng.permutation(n) for _ in range(N_PERM))
    null_max = np.array([np.abs(spearman_all(Ar, yr[list(p)])).max() for p in perms])
    p_fwe = pd.Series([(np.sum(null_max >= abs(v)) + 1) / (len(null_max) + 1) for v in r.values],
                      index=A.columns)

    # jackknife sign consistency and minimum |r| across drop-one-patient analyses
    jk = []
    for held, (train, yj) in jk_targets.items():
        jk.append(pd.Series(spearman_all(A.loc[train].rank(axis=0).values, rankdata(yj.values)),
                            index=A.columns))
    jk = pd.DataFrame(jk)

    # fraction of each set's genes that are in the signature
    sig_genes = set(sig_full["up"] + sig_full["down"])
    overlap = net.groupby("source")["target"].apply(
        lambda g: len(set(g) & sig_genes) / len(g)).reindex(A.columns)

    return pd.DataFrame({
        "database": db,
        "pathway": A.columns,
        "spearman_r": r.values,
        "p_raw": p_raw.values,
        "p_fwe_within_db": p_fwe.values,
        "jackknife_sign_consistency": (np.sign(jk) == np.sign(r)).mean(axis=0).values,
        "min_abs_r_jackknife": jk.abs().min().values,
        "signature_overlap": overlap.values,
    })

# ---------------- run all databases ----------------
tables = []
for db, (fname, prefix) in GMT_FILES.items():
    net = read_gmt(fname, require_prefix=prefix)
    print(f"{db}: {net['source'].nunique()} sets after size filter")
    tables.append(score_database(net, db))

results = pd.concat(tables, ignore_index=True)
# BH across ALL pathways from ALL databases
results["q_bh_all"] = multipletests(results["p_raw"], method="fdr_bh")[1]
results = results.sort_values("p_raw").reset_index(drop=True)
results.to_csv("early_pathway_persistence_all_databases.csv", index=False)
print(results.head(20).round(3))

data = early_pb    # all early candidate genes, signature genes included

def pathway_activity(data):
    out = dc.mt.ulm(data=data, net=net)
    est = out[0] if isinstance(out, tuple) else out   # handle tuple vs single return
    return est

A = pathway_activity(data)
A = A.loc[labeled]
A = A.loc[:, A.std() > 0]
print(f"{A.shape[1]} pathways scored")

# ---------------- association with the persistence score ----------------
Ar = A.rank(axis=0).values
yr = rankdata(y.values)
r_obs = pd.Series(spearman_all(Ar, yr), index=A.columns)

# Raw p-values (t approximation to Spearman, n = 7 so interpret cautiously)
n = len(labeled)
t_stat = r_obs * np.sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - r_obs**2 + 1e-12))
from scipy.stats import t as tdist
p_raw = pd.Series(2 * tdist.sf(np.abs(t_stat), df=n - 2), index=A.columns)
q_bh = pd.Series(multipletests(p_raw.values, method="fdr_bh")[1], index=A.columns)

# ---------------- family-wise null: max |r| over pathways under shuffled y ----------------
if n <= 8:
    perms = permutations(range(n))
else:
    perms = (rng.permutation(n) for _ in range(N_PERM))
null_max = np.array([np.abs(spearman_all(Ar, yr[list(p)])).max() for p in perms])
p_fwe = pd.Series([(np.sum(null_max >= abs(r)) + 1) / (len(null_max) + 1)
                   for r in r_obs.values], index=A.columns)

# ---------------- jackknife: rebuild signature without each patient ----------------
jk_r = []
for held in labeled:
    train = [p for p in labeled if p != held]
    sig_j = derive_signature(train)
    if sig_j is None:
        print(f"jackknife skip {held}: no usable signature")
        continue
    yj = patient_score(sig_j).loc[train]
    Aj = A.loc[train]
    jk_r.append(pd.Series(spearman_all(Aj.rank(axis=0).values, rankdata(yj.values)),
                          index=A.columns))
jk = pd.DataFrame(jk_r)
sign_consistent = (np.sign(jk) == np.sign(r_obs)).mean(axis=0)

# ---------------- overlap with the signature genes ----------------
overlap = {}
for pw, genes_pw in net.groupby("source")["target"]:
    genes_pw = set(genes_pw)
    overlap[pw] = len(genes_pw & sig_genes) / max(len(genes_pw), 1)
overlap = pd.Series(overlap).reindex(A.columns)

# ---------------- summarise ----------------
results = pd.DataFrame({
    "spearman_r": r_obs,
    "p_raw": p_raw,
    "q_bh": q_bh,
    "p_fwe": p_fwe,
    "jackknife_sign_consistency": sign_consistent,
    "min_abs_r_jackknife": jk.abs().min(),
    "signature_overlap": overlap,
}).sort_values("p_raw")
results.to_csv("early_pathway_persistence_associations.csv")
print(results.head(20).round(3))
```

```{python}
top = results.head(6).index
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(12, 7.5))

for ax, pw in zip(axes.ravel(), top):
    x = A.loc[labeled, pw]
    yy = y.loc[labeled]
    ax.scatter(x, yy, s=60, color="steelblue", edgecolor="k", zorder=3)
    for p in labeled:
        ax.annotate(p, (x[p], yy[p]), textcoords="offset points",
                    xytext=(5, 4), fontsize=9)

    # Least-squares line as a visual guide only; the test is Spearman
    slope, intercept = np.polyfit(x, yy, 1)
    xs = np.linspace(x.min(), x.max(), 50)
    ax.plot(xs, slope * xs + intercept, ls="--", color="grey", lw=1)

    r = results.loc[pw, "spearman_r"]
    q = results.loc[pw, "q_bh"]
    ax.set_title(f"{pw}\nSpearman ρ = {r:.2f}, q = {q:.2f}", fontsize=9)
    ax.set_xlabel("Early pathway activity (ulm score)", fontsize=9)
    ax.set_ylabel("Late persistence score", fontsize=9)

for ax in axes.ravel()[len(top):]:
    ax.set_visible(False)

fig.suptitle("Early pathway activity vs late persistence score (n = 7 patients)", fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("pathway_scatter_top6.png", dpi=300)
plt.show()
```
